gdef_classes_fea: the release classes dotaccentcmb (U+0307) as a base glyph, which no glyph category expresses for a combining mark, and the build without it places the mark differently (tools/probes/hg_forks_from_binary)
disclose: Combining marks are placed by the shaper from glyph bounding boxes (the font has no GPOS). 3 of the released font's glyf bounding boxes are stale, while a compiled font's are exact, so 59 of 25648 base+mark pairs place the mark differently, by up to 1 units (of 2048) (tools/probes/hg_forks_from_binary).
